summary.en: On the phone: "I saw your part-time job ad and am calling. My name is ___. Could I have an interview?" Students can say first: "I have permission to work part-time, up to 28 hours a week." Common words: shift, hourly wage, transport allowance, makanai (staff meal), training. Use a CV photo taken within 3 months. The Nagoya Employment Service Center for Foreigners can check your CV (author's experience; to be checked).
